newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 1,500 METRES CHAMPION EL GUERROUJ.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 1,500 METRES CHAMPION EL GUERROUJ.

text.p: Profile of Hicham El Guerrouj, who won the world men's 1,500 metres title on Wednesday.
Tripped over Algerian Noureddine Morceli's foot and fell while making a move to the front in the Olympic 1,500 metres final last year in Atlanta.
Was undefeated in the 1,500 for the remainder of the season, beating Morceli in the Grand Prix final in Milan in September.
Had a succesful indoor season with world records in both the mile and the 1,500, in which he clocked three minutes 31.18 seconds, breaking Morceli's previous mark by almost three seconds.
Holds the three fastest times of 1997 including a year's best of 3:29.30 last month in Stockholm.
